promptBase: Create one wide 16:9 Minecraft first-person gameplay screenshot for a Turkish server guide. Use the reference as a strict reference for the same held ornate cyan, indigo and lavender sword on the RIGHT, same red-and-white Zero Two sleeve at bottom right, identical centered white crosshair and bottom survival HUD: ten hearts, hunger icons, green level 7, hotbar sword slot 1 selected, purple pickaxe slot 2, purple axe slot 3, slots 4 to 8 empty and gray blocks 17 in slot 9. Replace the WORLD completely with the requested setting. Grand detailed megabuilds with true voxel/block textures, convincing Minecraft gameplay, clear daylight or readable lighting. The world fills frame; keep lower-left readable for later HTML chat, but render NO chat, NO text, NO logos, NO labels, NO other UI beyond crosshair/HUD. Landscape 16:9 composition, sharp clean pixel edges. Setting:

scenes.name: harbor
